name: PETROCHINA YC1 ADR/100
summary: PetroChina Co. Ltd. ADR represents American Depositary Receipts of PetroChina Company Limited, a Chinese oil and gas company and one of the largest integrated energy companies in the world. It engages in a range of activities related to oil and gas, including exploration, production, refining, transportation, and marketing. The company is headquartered in Beijing, China.
